T1.fr: 10/10 habitudes pour avoir un charisme de dingue
T1.texte: no phone in bed for [[21 days]]: a little diary

en: putting things off feels harmless in the moment,
but it slowly becomes your default response to
T2.fr: repousser les choses, [[ça paraît pas grave]] sur le moment, mais petit à petit ça devient [[ton réflexe dès que c'est dur]]
T2.texte: phone charging in the kitchen, me in bed with nothing to do. reached for the nightstand five times out of habit

T3.fr: plus tu repousses un truc, plus il [[pèse lourd]]
T3.texte: with no video playing, the silence felt [[so loud]]

en: start before you feel ready. your 20s disappear
quickly when everything important keeps getting
T4.fr: commence [[avant d'être prête]]. [[tes 20 ans passent à toute vitesse]] si tout ce qui compte est toujours remis à “demain”
T4.texte: took me ages to fall asleep. not because i wasn't tired, my brain just [[didn't know how to switch off]] without a screen

en: most people can’t sit alone with their thoughts for
a few minutes without grabbing their phone
T2.fr: la plupart des gens tiennent pas quelques minutes [[seuls avec leurs pensées]] sans attraper leur tel
T2.texte: lay there staring at the ceiling, replaying every awkward thing i've said since middle school

T3.fr: c'est prouvé, la méditation [[renforce ton cortex préfrontal]]
T3.texte: out of pure boredom i picked up [[the book on my nightstand]]

T4.fr: celle qui gère [[ta concentration et ton self-control]]
T4.texte: and i was [[asleep by page 6]]. didn't see that coming

en: you say you want to read
T2.fr: tu dis que [[tu veux apprendre plus]], puis tu [[scrolles toute la journée]]
T2.texte: the couch was the trap. "one quick check" kept turning into an hour of reels

en: i used to be the same until
blocks my apps until i read
T3.fr: [[j'étais pareille]], jusqu'à ce que je remplace mon scroll par [[5 min par jour sur l'appli Sophia]]
T3.texte: without that hour i'm actually sleepy at 11, instead of [[wide awake at 1am]] and mad at myself

T4.fr: ça muscle ta patience, ton attention, ta mémoire, et tu tiens enfin [[sans stimulation non-stop]]
T4.texte: what changed it: instagram without Reels, tiktok blocked, messages still there. that's [[the UnSwipe app]]

T2.fr: mets [[toujours]] un truc en fond : musique, podcast, youtube, n'importe quoi
T2.texte: rough day, so i brought my phone to bed for "just 5 minutes". big mistake

T3.fr: ton cerveau ne doit jamais s'entendre penser
T3.texte: suddenly it was [[1am]] and i was still going

en: or you might start thinking about what you
actually want, what you're avoiding, or what
needs to change. that would be scary
T4.fr: sinon tu risques de penser à ce que tu [[veux vraiment]], à ce que [[tu fuis]], à ce qui [[doit changer]]. et ça, ça fait peur
T4.texte: woke up [[foggy and annoyed]], and it clicked how much better the other nights had been. the phone went straight back to the kitchen

T2.fr: Les bonnes idées ont besoin d'espace pour pousser
T2.texte: the first thing i see is [[the window]], not a screen

T3.fr: Arrête de scroller dès que t'as 2 min
T3.texte: and [[2 books finished]], all in bed
